title: A write, its standby copy, the backups and a failover
claim: Each write reaches a standby in another zone, backups go to Amazon S3, and a failover moves the same name to the standby.
alt: A sequence with four participants: an application, a primary DB instance, a standby DB instance in another Availability Zone, and Amazon S3. The application writes to the primary, the primary copies the write to the standby, backups go from the standby to Amazon S3, and after a failure the application reconnects to the standby.

messages.label: Write
messages.say: The application connects by DNS name and sends a write to the primary DB instance.

messages.label: Sync copy
messages.say: The write is concurrent on the primary and standby, which runs in another Availability Zone.

messages.label: Backup
messages.say: RDS automated backups are taken from standby and stored in S3.

messages.label: DNS moves
messages.say: If the primary fails, RDS changes the Domain Name System (DNS) record to point to the standby.

messages.label: Reconnect
messages.say: The application must re-establish any existing connections, now to the new primary.
